definitions.gloss: huge body, massive physique, large frame
definitions.explanation: An exceptionally large body or physique. Used to describe people or animals with an imposing physical size.

examples.japanese: {巨体|きょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}らして→揺らす：02479_yurasu⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Walk with one's massive body swaying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巨体|きょたい}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{素早|すばや}い→素早い：17093_subayai⟧。
examples.english: He has a huge build, but his movements are surprisingly quick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{力士|りきし}→力士：10115_rikishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巨体|きょたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{土俵|どひょう}→土俵：12010_dohyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぶつかり{合|あ}う⟦{迫力|はくりょく}→迫力：14310_hakuryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧だ。
examples.english: The impact of sumo wrestlers' massive bodies clashing on the ring is overwhelming.

notes:
{巨体|きょたい} refers to an exceptionally large body or physique. It emphasizes imposing physical size rather than mere tallness or weight.

FORMS:
{巨|きょ} (giant) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body)

USAGE:
Typically describes people (athletes, sumo wrestlers) or large animals (bears, elephants). Has a descriptive, somewhat literary tone — not commonly used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巨体|きょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}らす→揺らす：02479_yurasu⟧ (to sway one's massive body)
- {巨体|きょたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}る→誇る：14180_hokoru⟧ (to boast a massive physique)
- {巨体|きょたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧ (a person of massive build)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大柄|おおがら}→大柄：17177_oogara⟧: large-framed (neutral, everyday word)
- {巨漢|きょかん}: huge man (literary, male-specific)
